name: V3-room
reason: V3 on the 150,000 frame, the same number of losers inside the limit as on the 50,000 frame (0.1125% of the balance, $169 at the start). Tighter stop and smaller risk for survival: results improve as the stop tightens (READING.md: +0.05, +0.08, +0.16, +0.33 after costs from the widest stop to half width), and a tighter stop needs fewer dollars a contract, so $75 of risk still fits most breakouts. Rests on the same row as V2 and the full-width, day's-open and opposite-band tables for the same band. A stop of 0.35 of the width was not itself measured.
